headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: VER (17)

summary: Kimi Antonelli won the Miami Grand Prix from pole position, 3.3s ahead of Lando Norris, with Oscar Piastri completing the podium.
Gabriel Bortoleto made the biggest climb, from P21 to P12.
Charles Leclerc had a day to forget, dropping from P3 to P8.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car.
The stewards penalised BOT (drive through penalty).
There were 22 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 20 points over George Russell.
